title: WebCap Storyboard Scene Plan
description: Structured output contract for planning an ordered Story into independently generatable Scenes. WebCap assigns canonical Scene IDs after validation and injects referenced shared continuity descriptions into each Scene prompt.

sharedContext.description: Reusable concrete continuity definitions established once for the whole Story. Scene sharedContextRefs select which exact definitions WebCap injects into that Scene prompt.

subjects.description: Recurring people/subjects. Define stable identity and physical appearance as complete positive visual sentences. Do not put changeable wardrobe here.

id.description: Short stable identifier reused by Scene sharedContextRefs.

description.description: Concrete reusable appearance description suitable for verbatim insertion into every applicable video prompt.

wardrobes.description: Reusable wardrobe states. Create a new wardrobe only when the Story explicitly requires a clothing change; otherwise Scenes must reuse the same wardrobe id.

id.description: Short stable identifier reused by Scene sharedContextRefs.

description.description: Detailed concrete clothing/accessory description suitable for verbatim insertion into applicable video prompts.

locations.description: Recurring physical locations. Create a new location only when the Story actually moves somewhere else; do not redesign the same place for visual variety.

id.description: Short stable identifier reused by Scene sharedContextRefs.

description.description: Detailed concrete spatial/material/color/lighting baseline suitable for verbatim insertion into applicable video prompts.

persistentFacts.description: Other reusable visible/audible state that persists across multiple Scenes, such as a specific prop, vehicle, weather/time state, injury, dirt, or damage.

id.description: Short stable identifier reused by Scene sharedContextRefs.

description.description: Concrete persistent fact suitable for verbatim insertion into applicable video prompts.

summary.description: Concrete visible/audible intent for this one generation unit. Detailed cinematography belongs to the prompt unless essential to Story intent.

entryState.description: What must already be true when this Scene begins.

exitState.description: What should be true when this Scene ends.

sharedContextRefs.description: IDs from sharedContext that are visibly/audibly applicable in this Scene. Reuse the same subject, wardrobe, location, and persistent-state IDs across Scenes until the Story explicitly changes them. WebCap injects these definitions verbatim into the H3 prompt.

suggestedDurationSeconds.description: Suggested MiniMax H3 clip duration in seconds for the current Storyboard workflow.

continuesPreviousScene.description: True when this Scene directly inherits the previous Scene's exit state rather than acting as a continuity reset.

carryForward.description: Changed state established by this Scene that must remain true later until superseded. Do not repeat static sharedContext definitions here.

prompt.description: Scene-specific MiniMax H3 base prompt content. Do not restate sharedContext definitions here; WebCap injects the exact referenced definitions before rendering the final prompt.

integrated_multimodal_description.description: Chronological audiovisual action/camera description for this Scene. Begin with [Shot 1]; later shots may use H3 cut timestamps. Assume WebCap will prepend referenced shared continuity descriptions immediately after [Shot 1].

overall_soundscape.description: Clip-wide ambience, Foley, impacts, and non-dialogue diegetic sound.

non_diegetic_music.description: Audience-only score, or N/A when no non-diegetic score is intended.
